verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a homepage activity-feed snippet showing authentication and account events such as created sessions, revoked tokens and enabled 2FA. That implies some activity logging, but no docs describe it as an audit-log feature. Missing for 10: documented audit-log capture of auth and admin actions, tamper-evidence or integrity guarantees, streaming/webhook or export to a SIEM, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
